name: @maxclix/monorepo
description: maxclicks: AI Agents & Agentic customer engagement platform

scripts.postinstall: npm run .install:shared && npm run .install:server && npm run .install:web
scripts.push:stage: npx git-branch-is main && git diff --exit-code && git pull -f && git checkout stage && git pull -f && git merge main && git push -f && git checkout main
scripts.push:live: npx git-branch-is main && git diff --exit-code && git pull -f && git checkout live && git pull -f && git merge main && git push -f && git checkout main
